title: Localized cotangent conditions descend along a field extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of the field-extension descent lemma, the localized Kähler differentials at the contracted prime are projective and the localized first cotangent homology is subsingleton.

source.place: Lemma 00TG, faithful-flat descent of cotangent conditions

proof.text: Construct the flat base-change equivalences for H1 cotangent homology and Kähler differentials using Mathlib tensor-product base-change lemmas.

Use tensor commutation and flatness over a field to show S → K ⊗[k] S is flat. The induced map of prime localizations is flat and local, hence faithfully flat by Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom. Compose the cotangent base-change map with the localization map using IsBaseChange.comp, cancel the downstairs localization using IsBaseChange.of_comp, and reflect vanishing by Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_reflects_triviality.

Compose and cancel the differential localization and base-change maps in the same way. Upstairs formal smoothness gives projective, hence flat differentials. Reflect flatness by Module.Flat.of_flat_tensorProduct; essential finite type gives finite differentials, so Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing gives freeness and hence projectivity downstairs.

proof_origin.place: Algebra.fieldExtension_cotangent_conditions; direct Mathlib realization of Stacks Tag 00TG

theorem fieldExtension_cotangent_conditions
    {k : Type u} {K : Type v} {S : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [FiniteType k S]
    (qK : PrimeSpectrum (K ⊗[k] S)) (hsmooth : IsSmoothAtPrime K qK) :
    Module.Projective (Localization.AtPrime
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal)
      (KaehlerDifferential k (Localization.AtPrime
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal)) ∧
      Subsingleton (H1Cotangent k (Localization.AtPrime
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal))
